C0897.title: Threat Hunter 2022 API Security Research Report: Average Monthly Attacked APIs Exceed...
C0897.summary: Threat Hunter's 2022 API Security Research Report states that the average number of attacked APIs per month exceeded 210,000, with attacks concentrated in four scenarios: marketing abuse, account risk, data theft, and traffic fraud. The gaming industry's APIs mainly faced account-risk attacks such as credential stuffing, account enumeration, and brute force to steal player accounts and virtual assets, while social platform APIs mainly faced traffic fraud, where black-market gangs fabricated fake views, likes, and comments to serve water armies and traffic-diversion rings.
